<table style="width: 100%;"><tr><td>compute_spatial_mev_basis</td><td style="text-align: right;">R Documentation</td></tr></table>

<h2>Compute a Reusable Spatial MEM Basis</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Computes exact or low-rank Moran eigenvectors and retains explicit state
required to project the same basis to held-out locations.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>compute_spatial_mev_basis(
  data_coords_projected = NULL,
  n_mev = 20L,
  strategy = "exact",
  exact_max_locations = 1999L,
  fast_eigenvectors = 200L,
  fast_seed = 900723L,
  exact_function = sjSDM::generateSpatialEV,
  fast_function = NULL
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_coords_projected">data_coords_projected</code></td>
<td>
<p>Data frame with 'coord_x_km' and 'coord_y_km' columns and unique row names.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="n_mev">n_mev</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive integer giving the number of public eigenvectors requested.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="strategy">strategy</code>, <code id="exact_max_locations">exact_max_locations</code>, <code id="fast_eigenvectors">fast_eigenvectors</code></td>
<td>
<p>Shared strategy settings validated by [resolve_spatial_mev_strategy()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="fast_seed">fast_seed</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive integer used locally for deterministic Nyström knot selection.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="exact_function">exact_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Exact Moran-eigenvector function. Defaults to
[sjSDM::generateSpatialEV()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="fast_function">fast_function</code></td>
<td>
<p>Fast Moran-eigenvector function. Defaults to [spmoran::meigen_f()].</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Exact results retain the current sjSDM values unchanged. Fast results use
an exponential-kernel basis and orient each selected eigenvector
deterministically. The orientation is retained for matching projection.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Named list with 'data_mev', 'projection_basis', and one-row
'data_provenance'.
</p>

</main>
